scripts.predev: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.dev: concurrently --hide "TW-WATCH" --names "DJANGO,TW-INFO,TW-WATCH" --prefix "[{name}]" "uv run python -u manage.py runserver" "echo Tailwind watcher is running in the background" "npm run dev:css"
scripts.docker:run: node -e "console.log('PHARMANEX Docker\nLogin: http://localhost:8000/accounts/login/\n')" && docker run --rm --name pharmanex --publish 8000:8000 --env-file docker.env pharmanex:local
